description: A protected category: the export handler has no authorization check. The later commit leaves the handler alone and mounts it behind requireAdmin in the router, which imports it, so the finding is fixed in another file.

base.src/db.ts: export const db = { users: { list: async () => [] as { id: string; email: string }[] } };

finding.title: User export has no authorization check
finding.body: exportUsers returns every user's email to any signed-in caller: nothing checks that the caller is an admin.
